name: Tower of Jump [FREE HALOS😇]
desc:
⭐Welcome to Tower of Jump! [FREE HALOS]

👍 NEXT UPDATE AT 200K LIKES!

This game is inspired by Tower of Hell and made by ToH fans.

Reach the top of the tower made of randomly generated stages before the clock runs out. Earn wins to unlock halos and climb your way up the leaderboard.

You can only use "/skip" in private servers, if you are the owner of the VIP server. Only has 30 second cooldown for VIP gamepass owners.
